subject: Action needed: a Hermes watchdog has no live coverage
ticket_title: Hermes watchdog uncovered — reported by r2h-observer
runbook: A Hermes watchdog has stopped reporting without another live peer that owns its alert.
A lone dark neb-ops-gcp reaches this observer because src cannot watch Team Nebula.
A lone dark src stays quiet here while neb-ops-gcp is fresh because TMN owns that
alert. A combined outage also reaches this observer.
Likely causes, in order: both boxes are genuinely off or unreachable; Tailscale
is down on this host so neither heartbeat resolves; or the heartbeat servers were
stopped without the checks being stopped.
context_note: The independent R2H host runs this observer. neb-ops-gcp watches its heartbeat
in turn and can repair the observer's check timer over a dedicated SSH key.
